text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government warns striking university lecturers to return to work or face the sack.
- Crude oil production joint-venture partners to meet petroleum minister to discuss new rules for the industry announced last month.
- Nigerian Breweries to acquire Schweppes bottling franchise from Coca-Cola bottlers Nigerian Bottling Company .
- Geneva-based International Committee of Jurists recommends that the European Union and the United States impose sanctions on Nigeria.

- Government has dispatched a delegation to Equatorial Guinea capital, Malabo, to try and resolve a dispute over ownership of an ill-defined offshore boundary considered to be rich in crude oil, Thisday checks reveal.
- Commonwealth officials expected in Nigeria next week to try and resolve the diplomatic row over hanging of minority rights activist Ken Saro-Wiwa for murder.
